items.headline: Publicis to acquire LiveRamp in all-cash $38.50 per share deal
Publicis to buy LiveRamp (NYSE: RAMP) in all-cash $38.50 deal; merger expected to close by end of 2026
RAMP Stock Alert: Halper Sadeh LLC is investigating whether the sale of LiveRamp to Publicis Groupe for $38.50 per share is fair to shareholders
